# Clavis Encrypt 3.9.2

## 🔑 Ready for Premium

- Clavis Encrypt Premium licence keys bought from our store now activate in the app (Settings → License → Activate), unlocking cloud folders, sharing, vault backups, previous versions and the command line.
- A Pro or Premium licence works on up to two of your PCs. To move it to a new PC, choose Remove license on the old one first.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
